headline: Aave opened the risk and technical assessment thread for listing Global Dollar (USDG) on Aave Arbitrum.
summary: This is the standing thread for USDG on Aave Arbitrum. It will hold the pre-listing asset risk assessment under the Aave Risk Framework, the technical asset assessment under the Technical Asset Listing Framework, and later monitoring reports and re-evaluations. The first parameter recommendation lives on the separate listing proposal. On its own the thread changes nothing; it signals a USDG listing on Arbitrum is moving through the process. Watch the listing proposal for the actual caps and parameters.
title: Global Dollar (USDG) on Aave Arbitrum Assessments
